reviews.title: It fits perfectly in the same tower cases as the B450 and B550 mobos.
reviews.comment: My main PC and running local AI models far better than the AM4 socket computers. Having two m.2 slots for dual NVME hard drives is great, and it came with a heat sink for both drives. As my first system with DDR5 ram, I'm very happy with it. Definitely get the performance CPU cooler with heat pipes to eliminate heat throttling and at least an 800 watt PSU if going with high end nVidia GPU.

reviews.title: Great Combo
reviews.comment: Paired this CPU board combo with an existing RX 6600 XT for a system upgrade from a 3900XT pre Christmas 2025. All my older titles play much smoother of course while my newer ones play like they are supposed to. I got this right as rampocalypse was starting and got one of the last decent addr 5 deals. The 7700X combo is a fantastic choice for budget builds if you can afford any RAM or have it already.
reviews.author: JZ

reviews.title: Good combo buy for 1440p gaming
reviews.comment: Bought this combo for my first ever PC build and have had no issues. Great value, easy to update bios, there's a heat sink for all 3 SSD slots. Only downside is I Wish there were a couple more USB ports and the wifi card is wonky so I bought an additional one. But that's probably more of a windows issue. If you play simulation heavy games (civilization, age of empires etc...) I'd probably go with a higher end CPU but works great paired with a 4070 super!
